projectDescription: A digital reference encyclopedia covering 274 entries on rhetoric, rhetorical figures, historical movements, and key theorists from ancient times to the information age — searchable, AI-assisted, and browsable by topic.
keyFeatures: 274 encyclopedia entries covering rhetoric from ancient Greece to the digital age
Full-text search powered by Orama search engine
AI chat assistant grounded in encyclopedia content (Claude 3.5 Sonnet)
Interactive knowledge graph visualizing cross-references between entries
LLM-friendly endpoints (/llms.txt, /llms-full.txt) for AI tool integration
Per-page and per-block user feedback system
Copy as Markdown and Open in AI Tools actions
Auto-generated OpenGraph social images per entry
Cross-reference links (See Also) and collapsible bibliographies
publicApiSurface: POST /api/chat — AI chat endpoint (streams responses from Claude 3.5 Sonnet)
GET /llms.txt — LLM-friendly index of all documentation pages
GET /llms-full.txt — Full concatenated markdown of all encyclopedia articles
GET /llms.mdx/docs/[slug]/content.md — Raw markdown of a single article
GET /og/docs/[slug]/image.webp — OpenGraph social preview image per article
GET /docs — Full encyclopedia browser with sidebar
